question: Which judges sat on the cases that refer to Section 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure?
cypher:
MATCH (c:Case {in_corpus:true}) WHERE $court IS NULL OR c.court STARTS WITH $court
MATCH (c)-[r0:REFERS_TO|INTERPRETS]->(s0:Section) WHERE s0.key IN $p0
WITH c, collect(head([x IN [r0.sentence] WHERE x IS NOT NULL]))[0] AS evidence
MATCH (j:Judge)-[:SAT_ON]->(c) WHERE NOT j.key IN $start_judges RETURN j.name AS item, count(DISTINCT c) AS n ORDER BY n DESC, item

question: How many judgments in the corpus cite PLD 2023 SC 588?
cypher: MATCH (c:Case {in_corpus: true})-[:CITES|FOLLOWS|DISTINGUISHES|OVERRULES]->(p:Case {citation: 'PLD 2023 SC 588'}) RETURN count(c) AS item LIMIT 50

question: Which Lahore High Court cases refer to Section 22A of the CrPC?
cypher:
MATCH (c:Case {in_corpus:true}) WHERE $court IS NULL OR c.court STARTS WITH $court
MATCH (c)-[r0:REFERS_TO|INTERPRETS]->(s0:Section) WHERE s0.key IN $p0
WITH c, collect(head([x IN [r0.sentence] WHERE x IS NOT NULL]))[0] AS evidence
RETURN c.document_id AS document_id, c.name AS name, c.court AS court, evidence, [(j:Judge)-[:SAT_ON]->(c) | j.name] AS judges, [(c)-[:REFERS_TO|INTERPRETS]->(s:Section)-[:PART_OF]->(a:Act) WHERE a.key IN $acts | s.label] AS sections ORDER BY document_id LIMIT 50

question: Which precedents are cited by both C.A. 435-L/2012 and C.R.P. 410/2023?
cypher: MATCH (a:Case {key:$a})-[:CITES|FOLLOWS|DISTINGUISHES|OVERRULES]->(p:Case)<-[:CITES|FOLLOWS|DISTINGUISHES|OVERRULES]-(b:Case {key:$b}) RETURN DISTINCT coalesce(p.citation, p.name) AS item, 2 AS n

question: Which Constitution Articles came up in the cases heard by Justice Qazi Faez Isa?
cypher:
MATCH (c:Case {in_corpus:true}) WHERE $court IS NULL OR c.court STARTS WITH $court
MATCH (:Judge {key:$j0})-[:SAT_ON]->(c)
WITH c, collect(null)[0] AS evidence
MATCH (c)-[:REFERS_TO|INTERPRETS]->(s:Section)-[:PART_OF]->(a:Act) WHERE a.key IN $acts AND NOT s.key IN $start_provisions RETURN s.label AS item, count(DISTINCT c) AS n ORDER BY n DESC, item

question: Which judgments cite both 2017 SCMR 1218 and 2019 SCMR 906?
cypher:
MATCH (c:Case {in_corpus:true}) WHERE $court IS NULL OR c.court STARTS WITH $court
MATCH (c)-[q0:CITES|FOLLOWS|DISTINGUISHES|OVERRULES]->(:Case {key:$q0})
MATCH (c)-[q1:CITES|FOLLOWS|DISTINGUISHES|OVERRULES]->(:Case {key:$q1})
WITH c, collect(head([x IN [q0.sentence, q1.sentence] WHERE x IS NOT NULL]))[0] AS evidence
RETURN c.document_id AS document_id, c.name AS name, c.court AS court, evidence, [(j:Judge)-[:SAT_ON]->(c) | j.name] AS judges, [(c)-[:REFERS_TO|INTERPRETS]->(s:Section)-[:PART_OF]->(a:Act) WHERE a.key IN $acts | s.label] AS sections ORDER BY document_id LIMIT 50
